metadata.description: Igor Waraxe's Claude Code mods: a status banner, spoken alerts, a recording mode and an effort picker.

plugins.name: status-banner
plugins.description: One status banner above the prompt: plan usage, the session's turn, speed, cost, cache countdown with a Keep warm button and context fill, a goal and next-step summary, and a heads-up after long turns.

plugins.name: spoken-alerts
plugins.description: Speaks two alerts with Mac, OpenAI or ElevenLabs voices: when work ends, the project, the thread and what was done; when Claude asks you something, a chime, the question and the recommended option.

plugins.name: rec-mode
plugins.description: /rec before you record or share your screen: masks keys, personal details and business figures, keeps private files closed, and silences every mod's sounds (spoken-alerts, narrator) until /rec off. A ○/● REC badge shows the state and switches it.

plugins.name: effort-picker
plugins.description: Haiku recommends a reasoning effort for each prompt you send. A row of buttons from low to max shows it, and Enter submits: it applies the recommendation on low, medium or high, and keeps xhigh or max.
